textRuns.value: All four cards work out the average of the same column. The first two give 200 because they skip the blanks; the last two give 120 because they turn them into zero and the denominator goes from 3 to 5. Look at the fourth one: the only thing it does extra is add a zero, which alters no existing value. None of the four is wrong. What is wrong is publishing one without knowing which.
